name: obsidian-timeline-view
description: Adds a Timeline view to Bases, plotting dated notes as dots and ranges along a zoomable time axis.

scripts.test: esbuild dates.ts axis.ts layout.ts --outdir=build-test --format=esm --bundle --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:obsidian --log-level=warning && node tests/run.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Harry Brown
